rationale: The agent modified the order and processed a refund without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It also failed to answer the user’s question about when the air purifier would arrive or to communicate shipping status. The user’s conditional request was to cancel the item if unshipped, and only if cancellation wasn’t possible to modify to the cheapest option; the agent did not attempt or document a cancellation check before modifying. While the agent appeared to identify the correct user via name and ZIP and act on their order, it provided final statements about the modification and refund without showing tool-confirmed outcomes beyond the write call. These issues fail the pass bar.
